cases.sentence: На седьмом году правления Аталии ___ решился действовать.
cases.translation: In the seventh year of Athaliah's reign, Jehoiada resolved to act.
cases.explain: The proper name Jehoiada is the subject of the sentence, taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Он заключил союз с сотниками, включая Азарию, сына ___.
cases.translation: He made a covenant with the captains of hundreds, including Azariah, the son of Jeroham.
cases.explain: The possessive relationship 'son of' requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они прошли по Иудее и собрали левитов и глав израильских семейств из всех ___.
cases.translation: They went through Judea and gathered the Levites and the heads of Israeli families from all cities.
cases.explain: The preposition из (from) governing the source requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Когда они пришли в Иерусалим, все собрание заключило в Божьем доме союз с ___.
cases.translation: When they came to Jerusalem, the whole assembly made a covenant with the king in God's house.
cases.explain: The verb заключило (made) with the preposition с (with) takes the instrumental case to express the party with whom the agreement is made.

cases.sentence: Пусть никто не входит в Господень дом, кроме священников и левитов, которые на ___.
cases.translation: Let no one enter the Lord's house except the priests and Levites who are on duty.
cases.explain: The preposition на (on) meaning 'on duty' or 'on service' takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Левиты должны встать вокруг ___, каждый с оружием в руках.
cases.translation: The Levites must stand around the king, each with a weapon in his hand.
cases.explain: The preposition вокруг (around) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Он поставил всех людей, каждого с оружием в руках, вокруг ___, от южной стороны дома до северной.
cases.translation: He set all the people, each with a weapon in his hand, around the king, from the south side of the house to the north.
cases.explain: The preposition вокруг (around) requires the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Они вывели сына царя, возложили на него корону, дали ему копию свидетельства и провозгласили ___.
cases.translation: They brought out the king's son, put the crown on him, gave him the testimony, and proclaimed him king.
cases.explain: After the verb провозгласили (proclaimed), the title takes the instrumental case.

reading.ru: На седьмом году правления Аталии и Адай решился действовать.
reading.question: In which year of Athaliah's reign did Jehoiada decide to act?
reading.explain: The text states 'На седьмом году правления Аталии' — in the seventh year of Athaliah's reign.

reading.ru: Он заключил союз с сотниками — Азарией, сыном Иерахама, Исмаилом, сыном Иоханана, Азарией, сыном Авида, Моасеей, сыном Адай, и Елишафатом, сыном Зихрия.
reading.question: What was the first action Jehoiada took to organize the resistance?
options: He made a covenant with military commanders
He consulted with the high priest
reading.correct: He made a covenant with military commanders
reading.explain: The text says 'Он заключил союз с сотниками' — He made a covenant with the captains of hundreds.

reading.ru: И Адай сказал им, вот сын царя, он должен править, как и обещал о потомках Давида Господь.
reading.question: What did Jehoiada remind the assembly about regarding the king's son?
options: That the Lord promised David would have descendants who would rule
That the son was old enough to be crowned
That the people voted for his coronation
reading.correct: That the Lord promised David would have descendants who would rule
reading.explain: Jehoiada said the son 'должен править, как и обещал о потомках Давида Господь' — must rule, as the Lord promised concerning David's descendants.

reading.ru: Они вывели сына царя, возложили на него корону, дали ему копию свидетельства и провозгласили его царем.
reading.question: What were the ceremonial actions performed for the king's son?
options: They put a crown on him, gave him the testimony, and proclaimed him king
They anointed him with oil and gave him a scepter
They dressed him in royal garments and blessed him
They took him to the temple and offered sacrifices
reading.correct: They put a crown on him, gave him the testimony, and proclaimed him king
reading.explain: The text lists these specific actions: 'возложили на него корону, дали ему копию свидетельства и провозгласили его царем'.

reading.ru: Услышав шум народа, бегущего и выкрикивающего приветствия царю, Аталия отправилась к ним в дом Господа.
reading.question: What caused Athaliah to come to the Lord's house?
options: She heard the noise and shouts of the people proclaiming the king
She was summoned by the priests
She wanted to offer a sacrifice
reading.correct: She heard the noise and shouts of the people proclaiming the king
reading.explain: The text says 'Услышав шум народа, бегущего и выкрикивающего приветствия царю, Аталия отправилась к ним' — Hearing the noise of the people running and shouting greetings to the king, Athaliah went to them.

reading.ru: Священник Иодай вызвал сотников, которые распоряжались войском, и сказал им «Выведите ее за пределы дома и убейте мечом всякого, кто за ней пойдет».
reading.question: What order did Jehoiada the priest give to the commanders?
options: To take Athaliah out and kill anyone who follows her
To imprison Athaliah in the dungeon
To exile her to another country
To guard her in the temple
reading.correct: To take Athaliah out and kill anyone who follows her
reading.explain: Jehoiada commanded 'Выведите ее за пределы дома и убейте мечом всякого, кто за ней пойдет' — Take her out of the house and kill with the sword anyone who follows her.
